study_design: Population-based case-control study; further analysis of a study conducted in 1970-1983
cohort_total_n_excerpt: This is a further analysis of a case-control study of 452 prostate cancer cases and 899 population controls that was conducted in 1970-1983 among the multiethnic population of Hawaii.
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer risk overall and does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.
